mapper.select: select r.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_report r left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.id order by r.id desc
select r.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_report r left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_report(user_id, report_type, title, content, plan, status) values(#{userId}, #{reportType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{plan}, #{status})
mapper.update: update oa_report set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, review_time = now() where id = #{id}
